ONNX GraphSurgeon API
TensorRT-RTX supports loading models from ONNX using the [ONNX Parser library](<https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt-rtx/latest/inference-library/c-api-docs.html#import-onnx-c>) . ONNX GraphSurgeon provides a convenient way to create and modify ONNX models.
Interface - [ONNX GraphSurgeon API](<https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/tensorrt-rtx/latest/_static/onnx-graphsurgeon/index.html>)
GitHub - [TensorRT > tools > onnx-graphsurgeon](<https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT/tree/main/tools/onnx-graphsurgeon>)
See also
